title: Optimise the agent workflow in six areas
summary: CI duplication, verification scope, skill routing, resource checks, workspace lifecycle and responsibility-based extraction. Verification levels live in docs/development.md and scripts/verify.mjs.

title: No automatic deployment, and missing data stays absent
summary: Financial, workforce, contracts, repository and issuer data that cannot be fetched is left out rather than filled in. Named legal findings require human approval before they are shown.

title: Withdraw the observatories from the site
summary: Politics, the labour market, Job Intelligence, wellbeing, the AI Act and the statute book are off the site. Every old address and /companies/* redirects to #what-does-it-even-mean. frontend/src/{compliance,companies,job-intelligence} stay unrouted because compliance:check and jobs:check read them.

title: docs/README.md is the documentation index
summary: 28 outdated docs and 6 run-log JSON files were removed or merged; root README and folder READMEs for frontend/, configs/, scripts/ and ml/ were added.

title: One fit script per clustering, and only findings may be posted
summary: Clustering batches 0-2 live in platform/publish/clusters/ under pipeline subject clusters, with run ids in cluster_lab/clusters/registry.sqlite and exports in frontend/public/data/clusters/. Results with status finding may appear on the site; the rest stay in docs/cluster-batches.md.

title: Old Bailey: licensed zip in R2 with attribution, trial text stays local
summary: The ORDA zip is CC BY-NC 4.0 and is stored in warehouse/raw/oldbailey/ with ATTRIBUTION.txt. Trial text is never published. ml.oldbailey.score refuses to export until all 2,000 gemma answers exist (871 on 2026-10-23, at 6,000 neurons per UTC day).

title: SWEDEN has its own delivery group
summary: configs/delivery/sweden.json; the baseline group excludes sweden/*. The Wellbeing Observatory moved to #wellbeing and old #sweden-* tabs redirect.

title: Library data: Biblioteksdatabasen (open API, no licence named) and bibstat (CC0)
summary: platform/ingest/kb/libraries.py fetches both; no contact data is stored. Terms used: BemanService01, Besok01, Publ199, Aktiv99.

title: Job-ad language 2010 to 2025: passion +72 %, creativity +21 %, competence -19 %, stress -34 %
summary: Per 1,000 words with the occupation mix held fixed, over 23 archives: 11,291,650 ads and 8,736,050 distinct texts. Ads grew from 132 to 445 words.

title: Future-oriented Riksdag speeches rose from 17.8 % (1994) to 21.9 %
summary: Within future talk, security rose from 27 % to 39 % (break 2017) and crisis from 10 % to 18 % (break 2008). Limitation: the first run skipped session 1999/2000 through a six-digit regex, fixed in 71761a09, and 21.9 % is the partial year 2026.

title: Riksdag moral-foundation shares stay unpublished until the owner's review passes the gate
summary: The owner labels tmp/mf-review.csv (300 sentence passages); python -m ml.moral.riksdag gate compares the single-rater F1 with the majority-gold English F1 before score may run.
reason: the English tagger sits only at the human ceiling, so Swedish output needs its own check

title: Moral-foundation raw text stays local; only figures and derived features go to R2
summary: warehouse/raw/philosophy_moral (MFRC Reddit text, GPL eMFD, ETHICS) and features/philosophy/moral/run are LOCAL_ONLY in warehouse_store.py.

title: The foundation tagger reaches macro-F1 0.32 against a human ceiling of 0.27
summary: In-domain random split, one annotator as reference; annotator-vs-annotator 0.27 (alpha 0.08 to 0.31). eMFD baseline 0.04 to 0.22. ETHICS with gemma: kappa 0.50 to 0.84, every subset above the shuffle null.

title: One shared experiment core with a registry of candidate, champion and rejected runs
summary: ml/experiments/: contract, leak-free splits, shared measures, frozen acceptance rules in configs/experiments/*.yaml, embedding cache per text hash, checkpoints and a heavy lock. Promotion, rollback and reinstate are explicit commands; the weekly job never promotes.

title: The GitHub runner is the deciding machine for champion promotions
summary: Stored registries for philosophy, symbolic and debates were replaced by the runner's repro registries (local ones kept as registry-local-2026-10-29.json). Champions: f367c26d, a224a175, b33f92b1; jobs unchanged.
reason: local and runner runs differ by a few hundredths in UMAP/HDBSCAN metrics, which is within the frozen margins, so one machine has to decide

title: The runner is deterministic; local versus runner is the drift
summary: Two runner finals for philosophy, symbolic and debates matched exactly (41051018576, 41051992370, 41073947884). Decisions differed from local in every domain.

title: Anything that passes its gate may be shown on Cluster Visuals
summary: GatedModels lists mlkit targets whose pre-declared gate passed; a card whose gate failed keeps the failure and loses its data file (ml/mlkit/promote.py).

title: government_defeat failed the amended gate: 0.646 against title-procedure flags at 0.661
summary: Difference -0.015 (-0.041 to +0.010), run 20261101-0258. It is off Cluster Visuals. polarization passed its speaker-shuffle retest: 33 of 33 sessions, mean AUC 0.649.

title: Dimensionality-reduction benchmark not adopted; the atlas stays on v2
summary: umap10 with exact kNN gave 87 versus 83 stable clusters, under the 1.10 clear-win line; openTSNE map kNN15 0.278 versus 0.094 for UMAP. Local run, docs/cluster-atlas.md.

title: Atlas v2: Ledoit-Wolf whitening chosen by a pre-declared rule, 87 of 137 clusters stable over 5 seeds
summary: 77,753 passages from six corpora in one MiniLM-L12 space with per-corpus whitening (purity 0.977 to 0.775, translation match 0.996). Links need BH q < 0.05 and a block-bootstrap lower bound above 1: 71 of 3,685.

title: Publication refuses a 30 % row drop on files of 100+ rows
summary: Override with PORTFOLIO_ALLOW_ROW_DROP. A partly missing dbt group blocks, --only publish keeps group completeness, and the heartbeat compares published_at.

title: Worker AI routes refuse foreign origins and answer 503 without the limiter
Every page is published, in one charcoal theme
summary: #start is about Anton, #projects is the overview and each project has its own page (docs/design-system.md). The observatories stay withdrawn.

title: The job assistant is the second flagship, refreshed hourly with an 8 h SLA
summary: Subject job_assistant in pipeline.yml. Live owner functions wait on the D1 token permission.

title: Job ads near real time by polling: Airflow DAG every ten minutes
summary: infra/airflow/ runs platform/job_assistant/realtime.py (collect, analyse, build, publish) with overlap handling, source-time ordering, stage state in pipeline.json and a lock. Twelve consecutive ten-minute releases on a runner, median delay 6.8 to 11.7 min. docs/job-ads-airflow.md.

title: Keep the hourly GitHub refresh as the production scheduler until an always-on Airflow host exists
summary: Then set JOB_ADS_SCHEDULER=airflow and JOB_ADS_PUBLISH=r2. A host budget is not approved.
reason: Airflow on a GitHub runner proved the flow but is not always on

title: Raw JobStream and JobSearch answers with recruiters' contact details had been pushed to the public bucket
summary: warehouse/raw/job_assistant/raw/ and warehouse/raw/jobtech/stream/raw/. The stored objects await the owner's deletion (docs/storage-and-serving.md).

title: Raw job-ad answers are LOCAL_ONLY, and push refuses to overwrite keys changed in the bucket
Idea Lineage extraction failed on a journal line without created_at; no events were written
summary: store.read_events now names the file and line of such an event (2026-11-02).
